generations.prompt: Night in a narrow street of timber-framed houses, moonlight, mist and one lantern. A barefoot medieval jongleur in an open linen shirt and hose, boots in one hand, drops from the sill of an upper window onto the loaded hay cart below, rolls off the hay onto the cobbles, springs to his feet and grins back up at the window; above him a young woman in a white chemise with loose dark hair leans out, laughing, and waves goodbye, blowing him a kiss; he hops pulling on one boot, hears shouting from inside the house, and runs off down the lane into the mist. Camera level, a slight handheld sway. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
